searchText: <amezianehamlat> @KamilChNethermind I have been trying to reproduce eest tests results with kch/eest branch but couldn't make them work with besu, neither with nethermind. Other tests are working fine on both clients. Am I missing something ? sorry if that was shared elsewhere, I'm still catching up as I just came back from vacation. <KamilChNethermind> Hi! You were trying locally with that? <KamilChNethermind> What was the reason for failure? <KamilChNethermind> Genesis file for EEST tests is pretty big and is in git lfs - so you need to ensure to pull it <amezianehamlat> re: **@KamilChNethermind** > Hi! You were trying locally with that? Yes, trying locally with no specific genesis file. Where can I find that genesis file ? Besu and Nethermind were returning syncing on newPayload requests, but wasn’t using the good genesis file <KamilChNethermind> on the kch/eest branch these should be located in "scripts/genesisfiles" path <amezianehamlat> With current scripts on the branch, it is using besu.json as genesis file which is 44 KiB, do I need to change it and specify zkevm one which is 177 MiB ? <KamilChNethermind> Yes please - specify this one, defaults on branch are not yet adjsuted <KamilChNethermind> There is genesis file flag for that <Arkenan> hey @KamilChNethermind can we merge this PR? https://github.com/NethermindEth/gas-benchmarks/pull/55 It's a 1-liner to use the "performance" tag instead of the "latest" tag for ethrex benchmarks. The "performance" tag should be more frequently updated. <KamilChNethermind> Yup, done! <Arkenan> That's great, thanks!
